Thanks Alex — looping in comp & recruiting. Below is a draft pay mix for SDE2 (platform) that fits our L4 band and the hiring manager's note. I attached a quick paymix workbook with total-cash math.

Proposed (base / bonus / equity / one-time):
- Base: $165,000
- Target bonus: 12% (OTC target; paid annually)
- RSU grant: $35,000 (4-yr vesting, standard cliffs)
- Sign-on: $5,000 one-time (for candidate's counteroffers/relocation buffer)

Rationale: this sits in the midpoint-upper quartile of our L4 band for platform candidates with 3–5 years of infra experience. It leaves room for an additional equity refresh in year 2 if they hit impact expectations.

Constraints / asks for approval:
1) Naomi, can you confirm headcount & TCV charge code for this hire so we can finalize comp?
2) Karthik, does this mix align with team-level budgeting and manager approval? If you want to tighten base vs. equity we can shift ~$10k between base/equity without changing total target comp.
3) Alex / HireFlow: confirm candidate expectations on start date and whether Amira has competing offers that would require a larger sign-on.

Attachment: 20261129-amira-paymix-draft.xlsx

Best,
